description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thudella, Ja Ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512200
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, property boundaries, encumbrances, and registration details for multiple properties in the Ja-Ela area. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
